title: Prepared-solve reanchor replay with IMS SIMPLE versus MODERATE
source_findings: XMI prepare_solve resets iterationCounter once; each solve increments kiter.
MODFLOW6 6.8.0 IMS MODERATE sets nonmeth=3 delta-bar-delta under-relaxation.
delta-bar-delta wsave/hchold/deold are initialized only when kiter==1.
method: Use one prepared solve per variant and the same one-solve-iteration then exact-tangent reanchor sequence. SIMPLE removes the MODERATE delta-bar-delta nonlinear under-relaxation default while retaining the same physical model/API law.
diagnostic_logic: If SIMPLE closes the exact gate while MODERATE reproduces the DSW-09 stall, persistent nonlinear solver history is causally implicated.
forbidden: do not change DSW-09 prospectively registered result
do not infer that SIMPLE is the production solution
